title: Frontend: First Missing Positive
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind First Missing Positive. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(values). Return the smallest absent positive integer in linear time with constant auxiliary space. Mutation is allowed. Ignore nonpositive and out-of-range values and avoid duplicate-swap loops.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
For length n, the answer lies between 1 and n+1.
alternativeApproaches: Prove that each successful placement makes progress and contrast the mutation contract with a pure implementation.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Duplicates; zero/negatives; all 1..n present.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
